$comment: Seed MCP server config. Grounds agents in official docs (Microsoft Learn always; Cloudflare docs when the edge is on) so generated code is current (mid-2026 idiom), not hallucinated. Write-capable servers ship commented — uncomment deliberately per repo. Scripts + CI remain the canonical provisioning path; MCP is the interactive layer (docs/edge.md).

microsoft-docs.$comment: Microsoft Learn docs MCP — search/fetch official .NET & Azure documentation. Remote, no local install. Always on.

cloudflare-docs.$comment: Cloudflare docs MCP — read-only docs search, the CF peer of microsoft-docs (Workers, rulesets, bot management). Same verify-from-docs rule.

cloudflare.$comment: Cloudflare full-API MCP — 2,500+ endpoints, OAuth login. WRITE-CAPABLE (DNS, rulesets, Workers): blast radius is the whole account — uncomment deliberately, prefer the scoped scripts for provisioning (docs/edge.md).

cloudflare-observability.$comment: Cloudflare observability MCP — read-only Workers logs + analytics; runs the docs/edge.md Analytics Engine queries conversationally. Pairs with app-insights below.

posthog.$comment: PostHog MCP — HogQL queries, insights, flags, errors. WRITE-CAPABLE. Uncomment when this repo adopts PostHog (docs/observability.md product analytics + the edge sink).

azure.$comment: Azure MCP server — query/operate live Azure resources (resource groups, Key Vault, App Config, Storage, etc.) via DefaultAzureCredential. Run `az login` first. https://github.com/Azure/azure-mcp

app-insights.$comment: Application Insights / Azure Monitor MCP — run KQL against the workload's App Insights resource for deploy-window queries, failures, latency. Fill in {{APP_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID}}. Pairs with the aca-deploy-verification skill.
